note: Rotation register for HazardNet credentials. `last_rotated: null` means the rotation has never been recorded — it does NOT mean the secret is new. Fill the date in the same change that rotates the credential; scripts/check-secret-rotation.mjs reports what is due and .github/workflows/secret-rotation-audit.yml runs it monthly. Procedure and rationale live in docs/ops/secret-rotation.md.

secrets.impact: Gates ingest, alerts and the privileged /api/v1/* writes. Fail-closed: an unset or mismatched key returns 503, so Vercel and GitHub must be updated together or the nightly ingest stops.
AI advisory tier. Rotate together with GEMINI_API_KEY_BACKUP so the cascade has a live fallback while the new key propagates.
Second Gemini key used by the fallback cascade. Rotate on a different day from GEMINI_API_KEY so a bad rotation never takes out both tiers at once.
Fallback AI tier in the cascade. No restart needed: the key is read per request, so a stale value shows up as 401s from that provider only.
Fallback AI tier in the cascade. Losing it silently narrows the cascade by one rung, so rotate rather than let it expire.
Last-resort AI tier in the cascade; losing it shortens the fallback chain by one rung and pushes more traffic onto the deterministic heuristic.
Service-account key used by Firebase-Store-Verify.yml. Create the new key, verify, then delete the old one in Google Cloud — two live keys are allowed, an orphaned one is not.
The same service account as FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY, held as one JSON blob for the serverless runtime. Rotate both in one sitting and record the same date.
Shared with whichever ingest API PUSH_TO_API points at. Rotate at the API end first, then update the GitHub secret.
Coverage upload only. A bad value fails the upload, not the build.
Legacy/optional — verify catalog only. If it is already unused, delete the secret and the manifest entry instead of rotating it.
Web-push identity. Rotating the pair invalidates every existing browser subscription, so this is a planned event: announce it, rotate, then let users re-subscribe.
Pairs with VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY — both must be replaced in the same change or every push 400s.
Play upload key. Rotating it is only possible through Google Play's key-upgrade process and would break APK signing if done casually — treat as rotate-on-compromise only.
Protects the keystore blob rather than the signing key itself; change only together with a re-upload of the keystore.
